hooks.command: [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = true ] || exit 0; { echo "== $(date -u +%FT%TZ) cwd=$PWD"; M=scripts/cloud-link-config.sh; D=""; for c in /opt/dotfiles "$PWD/../dotfiles" /workspace/dotfiles "$HOME/dotfiles"; do [ -f "$c/$M" ] && { D=$c; break; }; done; [ -n "$D" ] || D=$(find /workspace /home /root /opt /srv /mnt "$PWD/.." -maxdepth 3 -type f -path "*/dotfiles/$M" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed "s#/$M\$##"); if [ -z "$D" ]; then D=/opt/dotfiles; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/KristjanHS/dotfiles "$D" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; [ -f "$D/$M" ] || { echo "cloud-link: FAILED - dotfiles is private and not attached; add KristjanHS/dotfiles as a second repository in the session picker"; exit 0; }; [ "$D" = /opt/dotfiles ] && git -C "$D" pull -q --ff-only >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "cloud-link: using $D"; DOTFILES="$D" bash "$D/$M" 2>&1; } 2>&1 | tee -a "$HOME/.cloud-link.log"; exit 0
